description_en: Adds a client to the blacklist of a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system and revokes the write access from the client. The blacklist serves as an I/O fence
description_zh: 从CPFS服务中，将客户端加入黑名单，逐出其写入请求，起到IO Fence作用
name: AddClientToBlackList

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region where the file system resides.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the file system resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the file system.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.description_en: The IP address of the client to add.
parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client to add
parameters.name: client_ip

parameters.description_en:
This parameter ensures the idempotency of each request. A ClientToken is generated for each client. Make sure that each ClientToken is unique between different requests. The parameter can be a maximum of 64 characters in length and contain ASCII characters.

For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/25693.htm).
parameters.description_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
